neighbours.label: the count of study samples or subjects in a scientific report (digits of 'we screened 347 isolates') and similar sample-handling words
fire: In total we sequenced 347 bacterial isolates from hospital wards.
The team genotyped 512 mice from three inbred strains.
We recruited 286 patients with early-stage disease for the trial.
Researchers collected 431 leaf samples from the forest plots.
Of the 623 serum samples tested, 41 were positive for antibodies.
We imaged 158 cells using confocal microscopy.
The survey enrolled 274 schoolchildren with asthma symptoms.
Altogether 389 tumour biopsies were analysed by RNA sequencing.
quiet: In total we sold 347 tickets for the charity concert.
The farm raised 512 chickens in the old barn last year.
The library lent out 286 books during the holiday.
The hikers walked 431 kilometres along the coast.
Of the 623 runners who started, 41 did not finish.
The bakery baked 158 loaves on Saturday morning.
The school bus carried 274 children over the term.
Altogether 389 fans travelled to the away match.

notes: Top examples mix ' of' after isolation/identification with digits of sample counts ('79[9] symptomatic children', '21[1] endocytic intermediates'). Probe: 'We identified 211 mutants' 0.59, 'isolation of the protein' 0.17. Testing the count reading.
